response.sql: WITH overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), site_shares AS (SELECT st.zoneref, st.artifact_count, CAST(st.artifact_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(ot.total AS FLOAT) AS share FROM site_totals st CROSS JOIN overall_total ot WHERE ot.total IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_val FROM site_shares) SELECT ss.zoneref, ss.artifact_count, ss.share, ss.share - a.avg_val AS difference FROM site_shares ss CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE a.avg_val IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Database supports NULLS LAST syntax in ORDER BY. Some databases (e.g., SQL Server, older MySQL) require alternative syntax such as adding a CASE expression to control NULL ordering.
